assertions: Send X-Onlo-Config-Schema: 1 unless relying on its documented default.
Send If-None-Match with the last ETag and retain the last-known-good config on a 304 response.
Fetch conditionally after config_changed, foreground, or network recovery.
On config_unavailable, retain the last-known-good config and follow after_backoff; incompatible_client is not recoverable by retry.
